notes.title: Version Update Maintenance Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41700718/e0b829e97da190b07a2feb2f71b07aee3f6e77ed.jpg


King of Kinks will be undergoing maintenance to implement a series of new features and some game experience improvement.

 The game will be unavailable from 10 Jul 23:00 to 11 Jul 08:00 EDT. 

Please notice that the event end time of "AV Girls Great Value Pass" and "Land of Mu's Order" are changed to 11 Jul 22:59 EDT and remember to claim the rewards.

New Contents and Features:
1. Added new event,"Gunner Roulette".
- Gain rewards by hitting the targets in marksman roulette. The amount of rewards can be increased after hitting the same targets.
- The event will be launched on 12/7.
2. Added new event,"Gunner Festival".
- Unlock Sharpshooter Mode and get luxurious rewards.
- The event will be launched in mid July.
3. Added new event,"Magic Dice Cup”.
- Test your luck and get great amount of Hero Shards.
- The event will be launched in mid July.
4. Added new event,"Star Premium Summon”.
- Each draw can obtain up to 10 "5 star Limited Heroes"!
- The event will be launched in late July.
5. The grand prize of "Wishing Fountain" will be selectable.
- The function will be launched on 15/7.
6.  Added 6 bond story to "Outer Area".

Adjustments and Optimizations:
1. Optimize the display of limited heroes.
2. Optimize the sorting of privilege.
3. Role ranking Display Optimization.
4. Opulence Journey Daily Pack Display Optimization.
5. General functions and other interface display optimization.
